subject: The editorial signal beside Bitscale's news triggers
body:
Bitscale's intent catalogue names 15 signals and the news sources behind them: Google News and Bing News, company blogs, LinkedIn company updates, PR Newswire, BusinessWire and Crunchbase. Newsletters are not in that list, so the editorial side of the same question is unwatched.

NewsletterFIT reads the newsletter ecosystem and turns each issue into records: which publications wrote about an account, who sponsored them, which topics they cover and whether the list is rising. An AI pass does the reading, so what arrives is extracted companies, people and placements with the article URL and date behind each one.

For a platform already running 100+ sources and an 18+ provider waterfall, that is one more signal family rather than a new pipeline. REST for batch joins, an MCP server for the lookups your agents make.

If useful, I can send a sample shaped the way your grid would join it.
